thread:
reza: Heads up  rolling quant4v2 of rwd-v5-mini into staging (canary 8%). Early logs show A/B oscillation on shortform scoring slices + unexpected quota throttle messages for some customers. Need quick triage.
paloma: link to quick dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/onboard/rwd-v5-mini/quant4v2 
ev an: do you mean oscillation in metric (delta flips sign) or traffic weight oscillation?
reza: metric flips. NDCG for shortform goes -2% then +1% then -1.5% over consecutive 5m windows on the same cohort. weird. also infra alerted about token-quota-exhausted for a few high-volume keys during the ramp.
paloma: quota note: we have a per-key throttle rule that scales by model type. quant variants are routed to a smaller pool initially; autoscaler might be lagging. ops-bot can you confirm?
ops-bot: autoscaler logs: warmup lag detected for pool rwd-v5-mini-quant4v2. scaling latency 180s. Affected customers = 4 keys. Posted alert: POOL_WARMUP_LAG_1800123456.
ev an: for the metric oscillation, could be sampling noise + tiny cohort size. what's sample count on that shortform slice?
reza: sample count ~1200 per 5m window. decent but not massive. i suspect model score variance increased -> tie-breaker behavior bouncing rerank order.
paloma: action items proposal:
- throttle down canary to 2% to stabilize traffic
- enable "confidence clamp" fallback: if rerank_score_std > 0.08 and ndcg_delta > 0.02 for 10m, route to fp32
- temporarily bump pool warmup min instances to avoid quota exhaust for high-volume keys

evan: +1, add shadowing for the shortform cohort so we quickly get more A/B samples. also add a rolling CI smoke check to detect sign-oscillation patterns.
reza: adding tiny config snippet for the clamp (put in rollout policy):
```
rule: confidence_clamp_shortform
match: cohort == "shortform"
metric_trigger: rerank_score_std >= 0.08 && ndcg_delta >= 0.02
action: route_to: rwd-v5-fp32
window_mins: 10
```

paloma: for quota, temp workaround: route top-traffic keys to a dedicated warm pool (fp32) while quant pool scales. ops-bot will create warmup alias.
ops-bot: created alias and applied routing override for keys: [team-alpha, team-gamma, partner-X]. change id: WARMPOOL_OVERRIDE_1800123456.
ev an: how do we avoid flapping (oscillation) after we clamp? need hysteresis: once clamped, keep holdback for at least 30m or until ndcg_delta < 0.01 for two consecutive windows.
paloma: good call. will add hysteresis params to the rule. also add an auto-shrink canary thermostat: if ndcg_delta > 0.03 for 15m shrink canary by 50%.
reza: I'll reduce canary 8% -> 2% now and enable the clamp + hysteresis + shadowing. can someone own 6h watch?
ev an: i'll watch the shortform cohort for 6h. set alert if oscillation pattern reappears: two sign flips within 3 windows -> page #eng-oncall.
paloma: PR for rollout policy: https://git.internal/redwood/rollout-config/pull/601 (adds confidence_clamp_shortform + hysteresis + thermostat).
ci-bot: CI run passed for rollout-config PR #601. smoke tests: rerank shortform smoke ok.
ops-bot: canary adjustment applied: rwd-v5-mini quant4v2 -> canary:2% live. Warmpool alias active. Warmup threshold raised to min_instances=3 for quant pool.
reza: replayed 2h of production traffic against new config in staging shadow mode. oscillation disappeared, ndcg delta stabilized ~-0.4% (within threshold). attaching replay trace to onboard ticket.
ev an: keep shadow sampling at 100% for the shortform cohort for 12h so we build confidence. also add a nightly mini-eval that computes sign-oscillation rate across slices.
paloma: noted. if thermostat shrinks canary twice in 4h, auto-pause and escalate to eng-sre.
reza: owners: evan 6h watch, paloma rollout PR merge + ops coordination, ops-bot handles warmpool. follow-up sync in 3h or earlier if alerts.
ev an: thanks. adding a short note to the model-onboard ticket about the quota warmup fix and clamp hysteresis.
paloma: thanks team. :thumbsup: if the quant variant passes 24h with stable metrics we'll consider gradual promote with a 12h ramp and keep thermostat engaged for 72h.
ci-bot: monitor created: MON_LONGRUN_1800123456 (tracks ndcg_delta, rerank_score_std, pool_warmup_latency).
ops-bot: all changes applied.
